candidates.title: Several major Durga Puja organisers in Kolkata temporarily shut pandals for public viewing
candidates.excerpt: Several major Durga Puja pandals across Kolkata temporarily suspended public entry following a stampede that killed 19 people and injured 25 at Chorbagan Sarbojanin. Police arrested seven people, while authorities announced compensation, government jobs and an SIT probe

candidates.title: Fire at military base in Alberta: Canadian defence minister says fatalities, injuries reported
candidates.excerpt: A major fire at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta has left people dead and injured, Canada’s defence minister confirmed. Prime Minister Mark Carney and provincial leaders expressed condolences and pledged support, while authorities have yet to disclose the cause

candidates.title: BRS global NRI wing backs legal notice to ‘Velugu’ over KCR report
candidates.excerpt: The BRS Global NRI wing has criticised a report published in Telugu daily Velugu alleging diversion of water from Kondapochamma Sagar to former chief minister K Chandrashekhar Rao's farmland at Erravelli. The organisation termed the allegations unsubstantiated, demanded withdrawal of the report and an unconditional apology.

candidates.title: Puttur Deal Leaves TD Cadres In A Bind
candidates.excerpt: Telugu Desam cadres in Puttur face pressure to campaign for former leader D.N. Elumalai, who joined Jana Sena after the municipal chairman’s post was allotted to the alliance partner.

candidates.title: Egypt pledges support for Saudi Arabia as Houthi attacks escalate
candidates.excerpt: Egypt announced its willingness to provide military assistance to Saudi Arabia to ensure its security and stability. President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi convened the National Defence Council to discuss potential support amid Houthi assaults. These attacks have targeted key infrastructure, including Riyadh’s international airport and Saudi Aramco. Egypt has previously supported Saudi Arabia in the Yemeni conflict, although its role has been limited.
